evaluation_notes: Look for solutions that reduce coordination drag across roles instead of adding decorative UI polish.
A good answer should treat the workflow as a system, not just as isolated screens.
expected_qualities: Explains how the UX proposal changes team behavior across a multi-step handoff.
Identifies failure modes around adoption, overload, or accidental complexity.

constraints: Keep the product usable on desktop and tablet.
Do not require a full navigation rewrite in the first release.
problem_spec.request: Propose the best UX direction for a workflow where requests move between requester, reviewer, and operator, but handoffs currently feel opaque and error-prone.
success_criteria: Make the next required action obvious without flattening the workflow into a chat feed.

title: Workflow handoff redesign
